newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cargolux likely to increase rates on Far East.
newsitem.headline: Cargolux likely to increase rates on Far East.

text.p: Cargolux Airlines International said it would probably make a decision on implementing ex-Europe rates increases in the next few weeks.
Cargolux last increased ex-Europe rates in October 1995.

"In certain regions, particularly the Far East,the prevailing situation of fairly strong demand would suggest that rate increases would be justified. However, at this point in time, we cannot say on which routes. We expect to finalise our plans within the next fortnight," Pierre Wesner, Cargolux' vice-president, Europe/Africa/Middle East, told Reuters.
Wesner added that rate increases were also being considered on routes from Europe to Latin America.
However, it was unlikely there would be any change in rates to North American destinations where there was "currently a reasonably good balance between demand and capacity," he added.
There was little prospect of increases in ex-Far East rates because westbound volumes were too "erratic", he said.
Cargolux had entered the final quarter of the year with "moderate optimism," Wesner said.
"There appears to be a buoyant mood in the industry, with talk of reinforcing existing air cargo routes and the creation of new ones which perhaps indicates a belief in an upturn in the market."

Commenting on 1996 he said: "After a poor first six months, the market began to recover during the traditonally flat summer months. In our view this will continue into the peak months which lie ahead."
However, Wesner said Cargolux' 1996 financial results will not be as good as 1995's which were the second best-ever in the airline's history.
After-tax profits of $11.33 million were reached from revenues of $395.2 million.
On fleet development, Wesner said Cargolux had reached an agreement with Boeing to bring forward the delivery of a Boeing 747-400F on order from September 1998 to August 1997.
"While this move is part of our long-term fleet planning strategy, the truth is the majority of our cargo routes are more suited to the operation of B747-400Fs than B747-200Fs."
Cargolux operates a fleet of three B747-400Fs and three B747-200Fs as well as an additional B747-200F on leaseback.
Cargolux' B747-400F current flight destinations from Luxembourg include Komatsu, Hong Kong, Taipei, Johannesburg, Seattle, San Francisco, Los Angeles and Mexico City.
While its B747-200F destinations include Singapore Taipei, Bangkok, Madras, Abu Dhabi, Dubai, New York, Detroit and Sao Paulo.
